text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I still can't quite believe it... Is it 
truly me who—
choice_data_list:
You can believe it. It's an incredible 
victory!

You can believe it. That was a wonderful 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing you say that... it's finally 
starting to sink in..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Because I was able to dedicate... a 
single, beautiful flower of victory to 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Competing with everyone is... still not my 
strong suit.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if winning means I can prove how 
wonderful of a Trainer you are, then—”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: I need to work harder, too.
I need to work even harder, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: I need to work harder, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"No, not at all. Trainer, you've been 
working so hard for me... Even now, it's 
more than enough—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
All that remains now—is for me to deliver 
the victory.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Until the day I deliver that shining 
golden bouquet of victory— I will keep on 
winning, you'll see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Your words are very 
encouraging—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with you, Trainer, I feel like I 
can give it my all even in this 
competitive world...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Then—how about a review session after 
this? In order to become even stronger—
